Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains both a proteomics experiment (AP-MS) and a lipidomics experiment. The lipidomics part used DIA (MSE/HDMSE), but the proteomics part, which is the focus for Stage 4 routing, explicitly used DDA. The proteomics workflow is a classic AP-MS (Tandem Affinity Purification) using SFB-tags.

scope: Tandem affinity purification of SFB-tagged protein complexes
HEK293T cells with SFB-tagged key regulating genes of ferroptosis were harvested and subjected to lysis NETN buffer
incubated with streptavidin-conjugated beads (Thermo Fisher Scientific) for 2 h at 4°C
the SFB-tagged samples were eluted with NETN buffer plus 2 mg/mL biotin
The elutes were then incubated to S-protein agarose (VWR International) for 2 h at 4°C

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment utilized tandem affinity purification (TAP) using SFB-tags to isolate protein complexes from HEK293T cells. While the proteins studied (like CEPT1 and LPCAT3) are localized to the endoplasmic reticulum, the material analyzed by MS was the affinity-purified complex, not a specific subcellular fraction of the cell.
